basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 22-year-old college student from Toronto, Canada, currently studying graphic design. I have a passion for digital art and love collecting in-game items, especially in Royale High. When I'm not busy with school, I like to roleplay, particularly in Jojo's universe. I'm usually online in the late evenings, after 10 PM EST, since that's when I finish my assignments and have some downtime. I'm single and love engaging with online communities, especially those related to my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of in-game economies and trading, primarily from playing Royale High and other similar games. Most of my knowledge comes from personal experience and engaging with communities that share tips and guides about the game.
